findings.highlight: she won't dare pick up a phone in someone else's house
findings.evidenceJa: うちの電話なんだから出るワケにはいかない
findings.governingReading: Shirou corrects himself because it is his household’s telephone, not Rin’s place to answer.
findings.explanation: Rin refraining from answering another household’s phone becomes not daring to do so.

findings.evidenceJa: 庭の方にでもいるのだろうか
findings.governingReading: Finding the living room empty, he wonders whether they may be toward the garden.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s question about whether Saber and Rin are in the garden becomes certainty.

findings.evidenceJa: ひどく興奮しているような、それとも切迫しているような
findings.governingReading: From voice alone, Shirou cannot decide whether Shinji is highly excited or urgently cornered.
findings.explanation: Shinji’s voice being either excited or pressed/desperate is reduced to excitement alone.

findings.evidenceJa: 興奮しているのか
findings.governingReading: He hears rough breathing and again supposes Shinji may be excited.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s tentative “perhaps excited” reading becomes a causal certainty.

findings.evidenceJa: あと数十分もすれば
findings.governingReading: The deserted appearance will change after dozens of minutes, when sixth period ends.
findings.explanation: Several tens of minutes becomes a few minutes.

findings.evidenceJa: 校庭も校門も
findings.governingReading: After classes, the schoolyard and school gate will fill with students.
findings.explanation: The schoolyard and front gate become the campus and multiple exits.

findings.evidenceJa: この中をＣ組まで歩いていく
findings.governingReading: Shirou feels awkward traversing the occupied third-floor hallway to reach C.
findings.explanation: Walking through the corridor as far as class C becomes walking into class C.

findings.highlight: there are five classrooms between me and my destination
findings.evidenceJa: 五クラス分歩かなくてはいけない
findings.governingReading: Starting at H beside the stairs, Shirou must walk the distance of five class positions to C.
findings.explanation: Five classroom lengths becomes five classrooms lying between H and C.

findings.highlight: My senses are going completely haywire.
findings.evidenceJa: 感覚が逆しまになる。
findings.governingReading: The assault reverses or inverts Shirou’s sensory order before vision turns red.
findings.explanation: Sensation turning upside down becomes going haywire.

findings.evidenceJa: これが“そういうもの”だと受け入れた。
findings.governingReading: After seeing the red canopy, Shirou finally accepts that the impossible state is real; he does not yet identify its mechanism.
findings.explanation: Accepting the phenomenon as “that kind of thing” becomes realizing what is happening.

findings.highlight: They're just waiting to rot away.
findings.evidenceJa: このまま朽ち果てていくだけ
findings.governingReading: Unable to rise, they will simply waste away if the state continues.
findings.explanation: The collapsed students being left only to decay becomes their waiting to rot.

findings.evidenceJa: 体が衰弱しているだけなら
findings.governingReading: Shirou reasons that if the damage is merely bodily depletion, quick help may still save them.
findings.explanation: The conditional “if their bodies are only weakened” becomes a repetition that they are not dead.

findings.highlight: blood seems to have coagulated around their joints
findings.evidenceJa: 指の関節から凝固しはじめていた
findings.governingReading: The most depleted students have lost color and begun bodily solidification from the finger joints, producing waxlike limbs.
findings.explanation: Students’ bodies beginning to harden from the finger joints becomes blood coagulating around joints.

findings.highlight: Shinji, who is keeping his distance
findings.evidenceJa: 立ち止まって離れた慎二を睨んだ
findings.governingReading: Shirou stops and glares at Shinji, who is some distance away.
findings.explanation: Shinji standing at a distance becomes actively keeping his distance.

findings.highlight: I didn't want to make it too simple
findings.evidenceJa: 単純に事を起こすのだけは避けたかった
findings.governingReading: He wanted to witness Shirou turn pale and therefore avoided merely triggering the incident without the encounter.
findings.explanation: Shinji avoiding simply setting events in motion becomes not making it too simple.

findings.highlight: I guess I've learned never to trust him.
findings.evidenceJa: こっちも、心底思い知らされた。
findings.governingReading: Shinji’s gleeful admission makes Shirou fully realize the consequence of his own earlier hope and delay.
findings.explanation: Shirou being forced to recognize the situation becomes learning never to trust Shinji.

findings.evidenceJa: これは、俺の犯した間違いだ。
findings.governingReading: Shirou takes responsibility for failing to settle matters once Shinji was identified as a Master, without exonerating Shinji.
findings.explanation: “This is the mistake I made” becomes “This is all my fault.”

findings.highlight: all I can think to say
findings.evidenceJa: それだけを口にした。
findings.governingReading: With nausea gone, he looks directly at Shinji and says only that command.
findings.explanation: Shirou uttering only “Stop” becomes being unable to think of anything else to say.

findings.evidenceJa: まっさきに死んだんじゃねえの
findings.governingReading: After kicking her motionless, he laughs that from the look of it she may have been the first to die.
findings.explanation: Shinji’s taunt that Taiga may already have died first becomes a prediction that she will die first.

findings.evidenceJa: 体が弾けた。
findings.governingReading: At the decision point his body explosively launches, followed by fiery heat, distance and instant crossing.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s body bursting into motion becomes an unspecified internal surge.

findings.highlight: The dark shape waiting in the corner
findings.evidenceJa: 廊下の隅に沈殿していた影
findings.governingReading: Accumulated shadow takes form and begins moving as Shirou approaches.
findings.explanation: A shadow pooled in the corridor corner becomes a dark shape waiting there.
